results.question: For each country, find the customer who has spent the most money. Show the country, customer name, and amount spent.

    Country, 
    FirstName || ' ' || LastName AS CustomerName, 
    TotalSpent AS AmountSpent
FROM (
    SELECT 
        c.Country,
        c.FirstName,
        c.LastName,
        SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpent,

results.question: For each artist, find their best-selling album based on the total number of tracks purchased. Show artist, album and sales.
results.gold_sql: WITH album_sales AS (SELECT ar.ArtistId, ar.Name AS Artist, al.AlbumId, al.Title AS Album, SUM(il.Quantity) AS Sales FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId JOIN Track t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, al.AlbumId), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ArtistId ORDER BY Sales DESC) AS rnk FROM album_sales) SELECT Artist, Album, Sales FROM ranked WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY Artist
results.sql:
SELECT a.Name AS Artist, al.Title AS Album, il.TotalTracksSold
FROM (
    SELECT ar.ArtistId,
           al.AlbumId,
           SUM(il.Quantity) AS TotalTracksSold,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY SUM(il.Quantity) DESC) AS rnk
    FROM InvoiceLine il
    JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
    JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
    JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
    GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, al.AlbumId
) il
JOIN Artist a ON il.ArtistId = a.ArtistId
JOIN Album al ON il.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
WHERE il.rnk = 1
ORDER BY a.Name
results.answer: The query returns each artist’s top‑selling album together with the total number of tracks purchased—for example, AC/DC’s best‑selling album is **“For Those About To Rock We Salute You”** with **10** tracks sold, Aerosmith’s is **“Big Ones”** with **10**, Amy Winehouse’s is **“Back to Black”** with **12**, and Antônio Carlos Jobim’s is **“Chill: Brazil (Disc 2)”** with **15**. All other artists are listed similarly in the result set with their respective album titles and exact sales figures.

history.sql:
SELECT a.Name AS Artist, al.Title AS Album, il.TotalTracksSold
FROM (
    SELECT ar.ArtistId,
           al.AlbumId,
           SUM(il.Quantity) AS TotalTracksSold,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ar.ArtistId ORDER BY SUM(il.Quantity) DESC) AS rnk
    FROM InvoiceLine il
    JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
    JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
    JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
    GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, al.AlbumId
) il
JOIN Artist a ON il.ArtistId = a.ArtistId
JOIN Album al ON il.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
WHERE il.rnk = 1
ORDER BY a.Name

results.question: Find the customers who have spent more than the average amount spent by customers in their own country.
results.gold_sql: WITH customer_spending AS (SELECT c.Country, c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS Spent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Country, c.CustomerId), country_avg AS (SELECT Country, AVG(Spent) AS avg_spent FROM customer_spending GROUP BY Country) SELECT cs.Country, cs.FirstName, cs.LastName, ROUND(cs.Spent, 2) AS Spent FROM customer_spending cs JOIN country_avg ca ON ca.Country = cs.Country WHERE cs.Spent > ca.avg_spent ORDER BY cs.Country, Spent DESC
results.sql:
SELECT t.CustomerId, t.FirstName, t.LastName, t.Country, t.TotalSpent, t.AvgCountrySpent
FROM (
    SELECT c.CustomerId,
           c.FirstName,
           c.LastName,
           c.Country,
           cs.TotalSpent,
           AVG(cs.TotalSpent) OVER (PARTITION BY c.Country) AS AvgCountrySpent
    FROM (
        SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) AS TotalSpent
        FROM Invoice
        GROUP BY CustomerId
    ) cs
    JOIN Customer c ON cs.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
) t
WHERE t.TotalSpent > t.AvgCountrySpent
ORDER BY t.TotalSpent DESC
LIMIT 100

results.question: For every playlist, find the artist that appears most often in that playlist.
results.gold_sql: WITH artist_playlist AS (SELECT p.PlaylistId, p.Name AS Playlist, ar.ArtistId, ar.Name AS Artist, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = pt.TrackId JOIN Album al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY p.PlaylistId, ar.ArtistId), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY PlaylistId ORDER BY track_count DESC) AS rnk FROM artist_playlist) SELECT Playlist, Artist, track_count FROM ranked WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY Playlist
results.sql:
SELECT p.PlaylistId,
       p.Name AS PlaylistName,
       ar.ArtistId,
       ar.Name AS ArtistName,
       sub.cnt AS TrackCount
FROM (
    SELECT pt.PlaylistId,
           al.ArtistId,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.PlaylistId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rnk
    FROM PlaylistTrack pt
    JOIN Track t ON pt.TrackId = t.TrackId
    JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
    GROUP BY pt.PlaylistId, al.ArtistId
) sub
JOIN Playlist p ON sub.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId
JOIN Artist ar ON sub.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
WHERE sub.rnk = 1
ORDER BY p.PlaylistId
results.answer: The query returns the most‑frequent artist for each playlist—for example, Iron Maiden appears 213 times in Playlist 1 “Music”, Lost appears 92 times in Playlist 3 “TV Shows”, Iron Maiden appears 84 times in Playlist 5 “90’s Music”, Audioslave appears once in Playlist 9 “Music Videos”, Tim Maia appears 7 times in Playlist 11 “Brazilian Music”, and several artists each appear once in Playlist 13 “Classical 101 – Deep Cuts”. (All other playlists are listed similarly in the result set.)

history.sql:
SELECT p.PlaylistId,
       p.Name AS PlaylistName,
       ar.ArtistId,
       ar.Name AS ArtistName,
       sub.cnt AS TrackCount
FROM (
    SELECT pt.PlaylistId,
           al.ArtistId,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.PlaylistId ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rnk
    FROM PlaylistTrack pt
    JOIN Track t ON pt.TrackId = t.TrackId
    JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
    GROUP BY pt.PlaylistId, al.ArtistId
) sub
JOIN Playlist p ON sub.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId
JOIN Artist ar ON sub.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
WHERE sub.rnk = 1
